## Context
Remediation epic for the comprehensive quality audit recorded on ae1b-b2a0-a080-4b4e. Scope is deliberately narrowed to three buckets the audit flagged: (1) the CI default-suite reliability flake, (2) the assignee/user-facing documentation bug, and (3) the LOW-RISK, NON-OVERLAPPING slice of the file-size, complexity, and typing findings.

## Architectural principle (avoid recurrence, not just the instance)
The near-cap modules and high-CCN functions in scope share one root cause: **flat units that mix responsibilities/layers, plus duplicated infrastructure that every new call-site re-hand-rolls**. The shrink-only ratchets prevent *regression* but not *creep toward the cap*. So each child fixes the cause structurally rather than cutting lines to a number:
- Decompose by **responsibility/layer with a one-way dependency direction**, so future code has an obvious small home instead of re-inflating a god-file: run-mechanism vs. diagnostics vs. failure-interpretation (structured_run); CLI-facade vs. transaction vs. snapshot-rebuild (compact); public-API vs. recovery vs. git-primitives (event_append).
- **Centralize duplicated infrastructure**: the graph child promotes the 15-line _loader.py shim into a real loader+traversal layer (load_indexed_states + a shared bfs), eliminating the reduce/index/BFS logic copied across _blockers/_graph/_unblock — which is the measured driver of both the CCN and the file size.
- **Preserve public import paths** (re-export moved public symbols) so every extraction stays behavior-identical and touches only non-contended files.

Splits follow existing call-graph seams (AGENTS.md module-size policy); new modules are >=100 LOC; complexity baselines move downward only.

## Scope selection (why these and not others)
Non-overlap computed against the file_impact of all 212 in-progress tickets (audit ticket excluded); every NEW child touches only zero-contention files. Deliberately EXCLUDED:
- High-risk complexity orchestrators next_batch.compute (CCN 42) and import_ndjson.import_tickets (CCN 45) — core scheduling/import logic, not low-risk.
- The typing ratchet FLIP in pyproject.toml (contended x9) and the near-cap files runner.py/_config_schema.py/signing.py/_ref_lock.py/init.py (all contended).
- Already-tracked, out-of-requested-scope findings: mutmut lane (521b-04c3-572f-4514), repo-wide package DAG (44ea-43c6-b351-4d81), test-env hardening (def1-9c3c-6802-48bd).

## Recommended systemic follow-up (out of scope here)
The ratchets fire only AT the 800 cap / at the recorded CCN. A genuine recurrence guard is an EARLY-WARNING margin (advisory surfaced in the metrics lane at, e.g., ~650 LOC / CCN ~15) so creep is visible before it reaches the cap. That changes enforcement policy and touches the (contended) gate/CI config, so it belongs in its own proposal, not these non-overlapping stories.

## Children
- Adopted existing open tickets: fade-ea90-7564-4715 (CI flake bug) and 879f-5549-91e3-4d6f (user-facing doc drift incl. the assignee example).
- New non-overlapping tasks: split near-cap modules structured_run.py / compact.py / event_append.py; centralize graph loader/traversal to cut blocker-subsystem complexity; annotate the attest package to be typing-ratchet-ready.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CI flake fade-ea90 resolved (or root-caused with a durable fix) so the Python 3.11 xdist worker no longer dies in test_opcert_service_app.
- [ ] User-facing assignee example teaches a Jira-resolvable identity consistent with docs/config.md.
- [ ] The three named near-cap modules are below the 500-LOC target, split by responsibility along existing call-graph seams, with public import paths preserved.
- [ ] The graph loader/traversal duplication is centralized and the four flagged functions drop to their target CCN with graph outputs unchanged.
- [ ] The attest package is clean under mypy src/rebar/attest --disallow-untyped-defs (ratchet flip deferred to when pyproject.toml contention clears).
- [ ] Every new child edited only non-in-progress-contended files.
